videos.overview: The women visit a spa in Santa Barbara, Calif., but the afternoon turns tense; Eileen invites everyone to her Malibu home for a night of poker; Kim's erratic behavior puts everyone on edge, leading to a confrontation between Brandi and Kyle.

videos.title: It's Just a Scratch
videos.overview: Kyle and Brandi argue over Kim in the wake of Eileen's poker party; Lisa Vanderpump's dog, Rumpy, returns from puppy training camp; Lisa Rinna hosts a jewelry party, where Brandi gets called out over her recent behavior.

videos.title: Drama Queens
videos.overview: Lisa Vanderpump's adopted son, Max, decides he wants to take a DNA test to discover his heritage; Brandi and Kyle trade accusations while visiting Kim; Brandi shows up uninvited to Kyle's gay mixer where insults are exchanged.

videos.title: Sister Act
videos.overview: After the blow up at Kyle's gay mixer, the women discuss Brandi's influence over Kim; Lisa Vanderpump is nervous when her son receives his genealogy test results; the women attend Eileen's movie premiere at a suburban shopping centre.

videos.title: Surprise!
videos.overview: Eileen organizes a table-read for her husband's latest Hollywood script, and emotions run high; Brandi agrees to a 21-day cleanse but attending Lisa Vanderpump's surprise birthday party causes her to second-guess her decision to stay sober.

videos.title: Welcome to Amsterdam?
videos.overview: The women are forced to set aside their differences and work together as teams while taking part in Yolanda's scavenger hunt; the women embark on a group trip to Amsterdam; at a charity gala, Kim reproaches Lisa Rinna for talking behind her back.

videos.title: Amster-Damn!
videos.overview: In Amsterdam, Kim and Lisa Rinna continue to aggravate each other, culminating in an explosive dinner that causes Kyle to flee the scene; the women enjoy the local space cakes, but the fun sours when Brandi blows up at Kyle.

videos.title: Amster-damn Slap
videos.overview: The women split into two groups to explore Amsterdam; Eileen confronts Lisa Rinna about her lack of support; all of the unresolved issues come to a head while the women are at dinner on a riverboat; Brandi playfully slaps Lisa Vanderpump.

videos.title: Confessions of a Housewife
videos.overview: Lisa Vanderpump refuses to accept Brandi's apology; the women return home after a final dinner in Amsterdam; Brandi gets bad news about her father's health; Kyle angrily reveals to Kim what Brandi has been saying behind her back.

videos.title: The Party's Over
videos.overview: The women attend an over-the-top party thrown by friend Adrienne Maloof; Lisa Vanderpump confronts Brandi about the slap delivered in Amsterdam; Kyle gets angry with Lisa Rinna for not corroborating that Brandi is worried about Kim's sobriety.

videos.title: Reunion (1)
videos.overview: Yolanda reveals the difficulties she faces with Lyme disease; Kim declares she takes more pride in the roles she chooses than Lisa Rinna; Lisa Vanderpump and Brandi get into an argument; Yolanda defends her daughter against one of Brandi's comments.

videos.title: Reunion (2)
videos.overview: The Beverly Hills housewives continue reliving good times and airing their grievances. Eileen discusses how Brandi went from a high-school fan to a wine-tossing foe. Kim delves into her own issues with the soap stars and goes after Lisa Rinna. Kim and Kyle vacillate between anger and tears.

videos.title: Reunion (3)
videos.overview: The women laugh about who has the dirtiest mouth, Kim reveals threatening text messages she received from Lisa Rinna after Adrienne's party, Kyle and Brandi argue about Amsterdam's space cakes, and Kyle and Kim's relationship continues to unravel.

videos.title: Secrets Revealed
videos.overview: Previously unseen clips of the ladies are revealed. Eileen mulls over winning an Emmy, Kyle's daughter wants to pursue an acting career, the women snoop into Yolanda's past and Kim confronts Lisa Rinna.

videos.title: Life's a Pitch
videos.overview: Lisa Vanderpump is tapped to throw out the first pitch at Dodger Stadium; Kyle buys $75,000 sunglasses for her store; Kyle copes with her sister, Kim, who is in rehabilitation; Eileen suffers a loss; Yolanda shows up for Lisa Rinna's birthday dinner.

videos.title: Ciao, Tuscany!
videos.overview: Kyle and Lisa Vanderpump are enjoying a fabulous time zooming through Italy in a Ferrari and taking in the tranquil countryside when family problems interrupt. Meanwhile, back in Beverly Hills, Yolanda takes drastic measures to improve her health and Eileen and Lisa Rinna are stunned by her condition.

videos.title: Horsing Around
videos.overview: Kyle receives bad news about Kim after returning from her European vacation. Also: Lisa Rinna and Lisa Vanderpump jet off to find a perfect mini-horse for a birthday present; Eileen tries to juggle motherhood and her career; Ken's birthday bash is held.

videos.title: The M Word
videos.overview: Kyle reflects on her career when her 7-year-old daughter, Portia, expresses an interest in acting; Lisa Vanderpump invites the women over to show off the mini-horses; Lisa Rinna makes a shocking suggestion about Yolanda's health.

videos.title: Will Power
videos.overview: With her short skirt and flashy ring, Yolanda's friend, Erika, intrigues the others; Lisa Vanderpump pays an emergency visit to the veterinarian; on the eve of getting her breast implants removed, Yolanda makes an announcement to her children.

videos.title: Hamptons, 90210
videos.overview: The women travel to The Hamptons to celebrate Lisa Vanderpump on the cover of Bella Magazine, but Lisa’s feathers are ruffled when she feels slighted by her friends. Yolanda's ongoing battle against Lyme disease finds her in Cleveland--and under the knife. Kyle is devastated by news about Kim.

videos.title: Pretty Mess
videos.overview: Eileen is upset about being interrogated by Lisa Vanderpump about her "affair;" Lisa Rinna feels uncomfortable watching Erika's videos; Kyle's friend, Bethenny Frankel, invites the women to dinner, where everyone gets a taste of Erika's alter ego.

videos.title: Going Deep
videos.overview: Kyle hosts a book signing at her new Hamptons pop-up shop for pal Bethenny Frankel. Also, Eileen shares a secret from her past; Erika picks up a recovering Yolanda in her private plane; Kyle consults Faye Resnick for help in dealing with sister Kim.

videos.title: Busted BBQ
videos.overview: Lisa Vanderpump takes a tour of the space Ken wants for a new restaurant. Meanwhile, Eileen flies to Italy to spread her sister's ashes; and Kyle hosts a barbecue, where dramas sizzle over Yolanda's claims, plus a 20-year grudge rears its ugly head.

videos.title: Backwards in Heels
videos.overview: A joint anniversary bash with a burlesque theme is planned by Kyle and Lisa Vanderpump, but dramas spike when it's discovered Faye Resnick is on Kyle's guest list. Also, Lisa Rinna continues to feel guilty about a past discussion.

videos.title: Please Welcome Erika Jayne!
videos.overview: Kyle and Lisa Vanderpump try cryotherapy with Yolanda. Meanwhile, Erika invites the women to see her perform at an over-the-top San Diego club, and Lisa Rinna is accused of throwing Kyle and Lisa Vanderpump under the bus.

videos.title: Hearing Problems
videos.overview: The women have brunch at Kathryn and Donnie's San Diego home, Eileen gets an Erika Jayne makeover, Kyle meets an old friend who has advice about dealing with sister Kim, and Munchausen syndrome casts a dark cloud over Erika's pool party.

videos.title: Spinning a Web
videos.overview: The ladies take a spin class to raise funds for charity, but flying allegations mark the follow-up lunch. Here, Yolanda targets Kyle for spreading gossip and then confronts Lisa Vanderpump. Meanwhile, Kathryn tries to gain Erika's trust.

videos.title: Not Easy to Love
videos.overview: Yolanda hosts a dinner party attended by a music guest; Eileen is upset because Lisa Rinna won't come clean about her feelings; Erika is leery of Kathryn who betrayed a confidence to Lisa Vanderpump; Kyle and Kim come face to face after nine months.

videos.title: Objection Your Honor
videos.overview: Erika throws a dinner party to introduce her husband to the women; Kathryn receives positive news during a hearing test; the women get their hands dirty while doing charity work; Lisa Rinna shocks Eileen by revealing her thoughts about the others.

videos.title: Hearing Is Believing
videos.overview: The ladies shop for diamonds in support of Camille's cancer charity. Meanwhile, Lisa Vanderpump rallies her pals for a march; trust issues surround Lisa Rinna and Yolanda; and Erika's private jet is used for a trip to New York for Yolanda's Lyme Gala.

videos.title: Lymes in the Sand
videos.overview: Yolanda receives a Lyme-disease awareness award, erasing Kyle's doubts about her illness; the women travel to the Middle Eastern city of Dubai, where they attempt to dress modestly and avoid cursing; Lisa Rinna expresses doubts about Yolanda.

videos.title: Dubai Daze
videos.overview: The women explore the city of Dubai, driving through sand dunes, shopping at a souk market and experiencing an Arabian Nights-style dinner, which includes meat from unlikely animals.

videos.overview: In Dubai, the women go shopping at an over-the-top mall. Lisa Vanderpump attempts to apologise to Eileen while on the top of the world's tallest building, Erika gives Kathryn a birthday makeover, and the women have an extravagant dinner on a yacht.

videos.title: Who Do You Believe?
videos.overview: The women head to a party at Kyle's desert home. Tensions rise when Lisa Rinna comes face to face with Kyle's sister, Kim. The women react to the news of Yolanda's divorce, and Yolanda talks openly to Erika about the end of her marriage.

videos.title: Reunion (1)
videos.overview: The reunion provides fun insights into Erika, Kyle defends her friend, Faye Resnick, in connection with the OJ Simpson trial, Yolanda opens up about her pending divorce, and a conversation about Yolanda's health leads to a surprising moment.

videos.title: Reunion (2)

videos.overview: The women relive the fun and drama from their trip to Dubai; while the others say nice things about each other, Lisa Rinna and Lisa Venderpump remain at an impasse; via video, Brandi Glanville voices her opinions about season six.

videos.title: Secrets Revealed

videos.overview: Lisa Vanderpump introduces the group to her friend Dorit, whose permanent houseguest is Boy George. Erika celebrates her 45th birthday in style with a 1970s-inspired Studio 54 party and receives more than one birthday surprise. Lisa Rinna and Eileen awkwardly come face to face with Lisa Vanderpump for the first time in months.

videos.title: The Buddha Bentley Birthday
videos.overview: Erika auditions dancers for her new music video “Xxpensive.” Dorit's extravagant birthday party provides a few surprises, both planned and unplanned. At the party, Lisa Vanderpump shows Lisa Rinna and Eileen exactly where they stand.

videos.title: Going Commando

Back in Beverly Hills, Lisa Vanderpump surprises Ken with a $25,000 watch on his birthday, and Eileen continues to struggle with the loss of her mother. Later, over drinks with the group, Erika's short dress leads to quick peeks and judgments passed.

videos.title: Pantygate
videos.overview: Dorit questions whether Erika’s wardrobe malfunction was intentional, while Lisa Rinna dominates the fashion world with a 24-hour garment selling marathon. Erika explores a future in acting with Eileen. And when Dorit employs a risky maneuver to confront Erika, the ladies worry they won’t be able to escape a challenge they’ve taken on together.

Dorit hosts a dinner party where she and her husband PK question Lisa Rinna and Eileen’s grieving decisions. When confronted, Dorit remembers nothing, leading to flared tensions at a luncheon at Camille Grammer's new Malibu house.
